excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content:
Currently, if you set a high gas price you always pay the max.
With 1559 if you set a high fee cap you pay the min.

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: This is a *huge* usability change because you can set the fee cap to something like 1000 nanoeth per gas and still only pay the minimum required for inclusion.  With current system if you set a gas price of 1000 nanoeth per gas you'll pay 1000 nanoeth per gas even if 2 would have gotten you included.

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: For me, this is the primary motivator for 1559, the security benefits and economic benefits are nice add-on bonuses that we get for free.
